reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.
